items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His best bud was not me, it was Elvin Jones.

ctx.x: Yeah, but he came out early.

So, he was allowed to go over there but I got off the bus once and they told me, "Get on the bus and go back where you came from.” So, I had to take my lessons from Elmer James at the music hall in downtown Detroit. I wasn't allowed in one part of downtown Detroit. I wasn't allowed to go out there. In fact, when I went to Pepper Adams house, a couple times I had to go into the trunk of the car during the day. I couldn't be seen riding in town with him. When I went into the service my two best friends, one of…
So did the pepperoni come from… Did the Park to the Pepper… To the pepperoni…is that…
